name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is correctly a hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) — the 'also' lets the key come before or after the ball move, and the ball move is only the 'if' condition, so it correctly gets no Existence. 'Then pick up the box in the other room' gives the hard order Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) plus the hard Existence(target_picked_up), which together force the key without a redundant key Existence. The flagged redundant RespondedExistence traces to a task sentence, so it stays.

texts: If the blocking ball is moved, the agent must also take the matching door key at some point.
The matching door key must be taken before the target box is picked up.
Eventually pick up the target box in the other room.
